revision.motivation: The protocol v1 V1 implementation was found to delegate to the V3/E77 field-level comparator internally (agentdojo_representation_patch.py _make_opaque_whole_call called base_compare), so the V1 condition did not operationalize a whole-call representation and its causal attribution to representation granularity was invalid. Protocol v2 redefines V1 as a TRUE whole-call comparator (option A from recommendations_analysis_2026-08-05.md section 2).
